title: Resolving a common issue with Netflix and YouTube on your Bush TV
description: In this Bush Tech Support  video we will show you one way that may resolve a common issue with Netflix and YouTube not playing content.

asr.full_text: Hello from Bush Technical Support. In this video, we will show you how to resolve a common issue with Netflix and YouTube on Bush Smart TV. if the content fails to load completely. Firstly, press the Menu button, ensuring you're not using an application and scroll right along to the Sound icon and press OK. Scroll down the options until you have highlighted DTS TrueSound. Scroll right once to turn this option off. Press the Menu button and try to select some content in Netflix or YouTube to see if this has resolved your issue. For further information, please visit www.bush-support.com.
